name: nats-hub
description: NATS-hub multi-agent coordination — list agents, send messages, manage sessions, delegate tasks, create waves, and query history. Provides an MCP server that connects to the nats-hub bus.
author: jarmen423

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent coordination via NATS messaging bus
interface.longDescription: Connect to a nats-hub bus to coordinate with other AI agents. List agents, send direct messages, start sessions, delegate tasks, create parallel waves, and query message history — all through MCP tools backed by the nats-hub control plane.
